vars.STYLE: Art style: hand-painted anime feature film look. Semi-realistic and painterly, watercolour-and-gouache rendering with soft visible brush texture, delicate thin ink lines, realistic proportions, natural facial features with gentle anime stylisation, soft natural lighting, muted desaturated natural colour grading, subtle film grain. Characters and background rendered as ONE painting. Refined; not chibi, not cartoonish, not photographic, no oversaturation.
vars.PANEL: This is a single cinematic comic panel, not a character sheet: the character sheets are identity references only, so do not copy their grey background, layout or poses. Keep every character's face, hair, clothing and proportions exactly as on their sheet. Keep important content slightly away from the image edges, because the panel will be cropped a little. Leave a calm, uncluttered area near the top-left for a caption to be added later. No speech bubbles, no captions, no text except the shop sign, no watermark.
vars.WEI14: Wei is a 14-year-old Chinese (Hakka) boy with a single small mole below his RIGHT eye (viewer's left), shown on his character sheet.

jobs.prompt: The image shows the outside of a small Chinese-run village shop in rural Mauritius in 1972. Create a background plate of the INSIDE of this same shop, matching what is visible through its doors. Eye-level view from just inside the doorway, looking toward the back. A long, worn wooden counter runs across the room with an old brass hanging scale, glass jars of sweets and a wooden abacus on it. Behind the counter, floor-to-ceiling wooden shelves with tins, bottles of oil, packets of tea and candles. Burlap rice sacks stacked to one side, a few hanging bunches of dried goods. Rough grey basalt stone walls, a low ceiling of exposed wooden beams under the corrugated tin roof, a bare light bulb. Warm morning sunlight slants in from the open doors behind the viewer, with dust in the air. No people. No text except tiny product labels. {STYLE} No captions, no watermark.

His head is tilted up toward the LAM STORE signboard straight ahead of him. His small brown string-tied cardboard suitcase hangs from his right hand.
